name: Grace LPDDR5X via NVLink-C2C
notes: NVLink-C2C is 900 GB/s total bidirectional so 450 GB/s per direction; Grace LPDDR5X up to 480 GB. Measured C2C behavior characterized in arXiv 2408.11556.

name: Host DDR5 via PCIe Gen4 x16
notes: 16 GT/s x 16 lanes x 128/130 encoding / 8 bits = 31.5 GB/s per direction.

name: Host DDR5 via PCIe Gen5 x16
notes: 32 GT/s x 16 lanes x 128/130 encoding / 8 bits = 63.0 GB/s per direction.
